INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.

   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.

   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.

5. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.

6. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.

8. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

9. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information – Poetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 4.3.1 Writing to give information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Storytelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 5.2.1 Reading for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

7. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.

11. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Writing for information – Paragraphs.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information – Poetry; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading 5.2.1 Reading for information; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
